snippet.title: HEART of CROWN Release Date Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
https://playism.com/game/heart-of-crown/
Your role is to support the princess. The pinnacle of deck-building games built on the struggle for succession is here!
Steam release is set for December 18, and the Nintendo Switch release is TBA. Preorders are now open for the package release!
